ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New work, Closed won and later stages need Amount, Close date and Engagement letter status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_work", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Conflict check", 3, "Proposal", 4, "Proposal sent", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Engagement letter out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 8, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(Engagement_letter_status__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Close date and Engagement letter status before moving to Closed won.
